host.description: Cross-chain crypto swap aggregator and multichain NFT marketplace. Solana, EVM, and Bitcoin/Sui swap routing (Jupiter, Relay, ChangeNOW); NFT collection data across Solana, EVM, and Sui/Aptos/Movement (Magic Eden, OpenSea, Tradeport).
